gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: CI's step is `/template/scripts/docs-build.ps1`, a script inside the ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template container image, invoked via the local `docs.ps1` wrapper per CLAUDE.md's docs tooling section. `docs.ps1` is not present in this worktree (it is generated by Invoke-SetupDocs, not committed — confirmed by find, no docs.ps1 or *SetupDocs* script anywhere in the repo) even though Docker itself is available. Per CLAUDE.md: when docs.ps1 is missing, verify the PR's own 'Verify Documentation Build' check instead of reporting this as locally passing.

gates.name: Build and verify landing page
gates.detail: npm --prefix src/engine run build (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json, exit 0), then npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run check (format:check, lint, typecheck, test: 17/17 passed, test:browser: 23/23 passed using the locally installed Playwright Chromium — PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH left unset as the config comment specifies for non-Alpine environments —, test:build, test:merge: 'Package-backed merge proven'). Exit 0 throughout.

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: CI's step runs `npm --prefix site run merge`, which invokes the package-backed merge against `--docs-output ../artifacts/docs` — the real Docusaurus build produced by the prior 'Build documentation' step. That step did not run locally (docs.ps1 absent), so `artifacts/docs` does not exist in this worktree (confirmed: `ls artifacts/docs` — no such file or directory) and the real merge has nothing to merge against. The synthetic `test:merge` check inside 'Build and verify landing page' above already exercises the merge logic independently of this dependency and passed.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: Requires building the host Docker image, which restores the private SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting package from GitHub Packages inside an isolated BuildKit build context via `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=nuget_github_token` (Dockerfile:85-88) — independent of the host NuGet cache that let 'Test the host' pass locally. No NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN/REGISTRY_TOKEN (a PAT scoped to read:packages on the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repo) is available in this session's environment; `echo $NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `echo $REGISTRY_TOKEN` are both empty. CI's 'Positive route and probe smoke' check on the pull request is where this answer comes from.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Same blocker as 'Positive route and probe smoke': this step builds a second image FROM the first (`--build-arg BASE_IMAGE=subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke`), which was never built locally for lack of the same GitHub Packages credential.
